title: Ratio Drop Bar Conversion for SRAM Eagle 70 and 90
content:
Want to run your SRAM Apex 12-speed drop bar shifters with Eagle 70 or 90 derailleurs? Perhaps you want to change your hardtail to a drop-bar 29er? UK company Ratio Technology has just the piece of kit for you…

The Drop Bar Conversion for SRAM Eagle 70/90 lets you pair SRAM Apex 12-speed mechanical drop-bar shifters with Eagle 70 or Eagle 90 derailleurs and a T-Type cassette and chain, bringing the durability of a direct-mount derailleur and Transmission’s shifting-under-load performance to drop-bar bikes.

When SRAM introduced Eagle 70 and 90, many were pleased to see Transmission technology become available in a mechanical drivetrain. Now Ratio’s team is excited to provide an option for drop-bar bikes. The Eagle 70/90 derailleurs use a T-Type cable pull ratio that isn’t compatible with SRAM’s mechanical drop-bar shifters; the derailleurs are also designed for MTB cable routing and don’t include a cable adjuster.

The Ratio Drop Bar Conversion kit solves all these problems.

The kit includes a replacement link and fin, CNC-machined in-house from a single piece of 6082 aluminum, plus a rear-exit cable stop with an integrated barrel adjuster. The fin converts the Eagle 70/90 derailleur to work with Apex 12-speed mechanical shifters, while the cable stop provides clean routing for gravel frames and the adjustment needed when using drop-bar shifters.

It’s an excellent upgrade for bikes running SRAM Apex XPLR* with an 11-44t cassette, adding a 10-52t gear range (with an option for HG freehubs), improved shifting under load, and the robustness of a direct-mount derailleur.

To use this kit, you’ll need:

  • UDH-compatible frame
  • SRAM Eagle 70 or Eagle 90 Transmission derailleur
  • SRAM Apex 12-speed mechanical drop-bar shifters
  • SRAM Eagle Transmission (T-Type) 12-speed cassette
  • SRAM Transmission (T-Type) Flattop chain

Installation: Is straightforward — watch the Ratio installation video for a step-by-step guide.

Pricing from: £70 GBP inc. UK VAT / $76.34 USD / €65.42 EUR / $106.64 AUD
